title: The Bell of the Bell House
author: Elodie Okonkwo
blurb: Edmund Villalobos, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the last resident signs the papers.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
